# Unibox

> One declarative UI, two renderers, and Flutter handover.

Six packages separate the declaration model, server and Flutter targets,
small Material vocabulary, native mapping and shared test contracts. Hosts own
application state, page composition and handover readiness. There is no
DOM application runtime. Start with README.md and example/README.md; repository
rules live in AGENTS.md and API decisions in design.md.
